responsibility: Declarative list of target preprocessor macros emitted for ARC configurations. Each ARC_C_DEF entry maps one builtin macro name to a backend condition such as CPU family, instruction-set extension, multiplier/FPU mode, or ABI setting; arc-c.cc includes this file to consistently define or undefine the architecture-visible C predefines.
same_name_distinction: Holds only the declarative ARC_C_DEF macro list consumed by arc-c.cc; unlike arc-c.cc, it does not implement the builtin hook or call cpplib routines, but serves as the data table of condition-to-macro mappings for ARC predefines.
